question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The incorrect spelling is: **Burgaler**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling is **"Burglar."**
 
• Therefore, "Burgaler" is spelled incorrectly among the given options.
 
• **Burglar:** a person who enters a building illegally in order to steal.
 
 
• Example: The burglar was finally caught by the police.
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is:** Burglar**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Bourgeoisie'** refers to the middle class, typically with reference to its perceived materialistic values or conventional attitudes. (पूंजीपति)
 
• **'Burlesque' **refers to a literary, dramatic or musical work intended to cause laughter by caricaturing the manner or spirit of serious works, or by ludicrous treatment of their subjects. (कारटून)
 
• **'Beggar' **refers to a person, typically a homeless one, who lives by asking for money or food. (भीख मांगना)
